question: Should QQBot enforce the proposed 1 MiB ceiling, or align with Tencent's official SDK's effective 4 MiB inbound limit?
rationale: The repository has no documented QQ maximum, and choosing a stricter transport ceiling trades memory protection against possible valid-event loss; that protocol-risk tolerance belongs to the QQBot owner.

options.title: Align at 4 MiB
options.body: Use the effective limit of Tencent's official QQ SDK, reducing the current 100 MiB exposure without imposing a stricter OpenClaw-only protocol boundary.

options.title: Approve 1 MiB
options.body: Keep 1 MiB only with an authoritative QQ contract or representative production evidence showing every subscribed event shape remains below it.

options.title: Keep dependency default
options.body: Leave the 100 MiB `ws` default unchanged if maintainers judge message-delivery compatibility more important than the proposed memory bound.

recommendation.title: Align at 4 MiB
recommendation.body: Use the effective limit of Tencent's official QQ SDK, reducing the current 100 MiB exposure without imposing a stricter OpenClaw-only protocol boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history points to this contributor as the strongest available owner for QQBot gateway protocol behavior.
